Profile.aboutPreview: Journalist and audiovisual communications professional working across reporting, interviews and event coverage.
Profile.aboutContinuation: With additional experience in photography, content production and digital communications.
Profile.bio: Sofía Chernikova is a journalist and audiovisual communications professional educated at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos. Her work spans television reporting, interviews, event coverage, photography and digital communications.
Profile.aboutTrajectory: Since 2024, she has worked as a TV reporter covering events, conducting interviews and contributing to news pieces. Alongside reporting, she has developed experience in digital communications, content production, social media leadership, corporate communications and professional photography.
Profile.interests: Her profile combines on-camera journalism, visual storytelling and content strategy, with a particular interest in media, audiovisual production and cultural projects.
